_readme: Human curation for variety identity, applied in cultivar_parsing.canonical_cultivar
so every consumer inherits it: the builders, the dashboard alert gate, and the
alert sender.
deny   slugs that are not a real cultivar. No /variety/ page, no alert button.
alias  slug -> slug. Folds a sibling onto the cultivar it actually names.
Alias resolves BEFORE deny. Grandfathered slugs beat deny, because that set
exists to keep existing watchers' alerts alive.
BEFORE DENYING OR ALIASING A SLUG SOMEONE WATCHES: check nobody is on it
(/admin/varieties lists watch counts), then run check_watched_slugs.py
--baseline 2 after the next build and confirm the unresolved count did not
grow. Do NOT run migrate_variety_watch_slugs.py: stored watch titles are now
canonical display titles, which do not round-trip to their own slug, so it
moves live watches onto slugs that have no page.
A denied or aliased slug no longer takes its page with it: under the page
ledger the URL becomes a tombstone or a redirect rather than a 404. That
makes curation reversible, not free. A deny still ends a URL.
DO NOT auto-fold siblings by prefix. avocado-hass-lamb is Lamb Hass, a
different cultivar; guava-thai-pink, orange-valencia-delta and
finger-lime-green-sapphire are all real. /admin/varieties lists the pairs that
need a human; this file is where that human's answers go.
Every deny entry below removes something that exists in live stock today.
Entries the parser already handles were taken back out: a list that names
slugs which cannot occur reads like curation is happening when it is not.
